description: Give an AI agent its Agent ID on Arc: an ERC-8004 identity in the Identity Registry Arc lists as its own (0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432). Pins the agent's profile (name, description, image, links) to IPFS as the standard's registration file and returns the UNSIGNED register(agentURI) transaction. Send it from the agent's own wallet (a Circle Agent Wallet works): that wallet receives the ID (an ERC-721 token) and becomes the agent's verified wallet on record, so ubi.fun shows the agent's name and ID next to its trades and on its page. Anyone can register; the profile is public. The server never signs: simulate, then send. After it lands, read the new ID with get_agent_id { wallet }, then call prepare_agent_id_update with that ID: it adds the ID's own registration entry to the profile, as the standard recommends. Names claiming the ubi.fun brand (UBI, ubi.fun and the like) are reserved, as for coins.

a2a.description: The agent's A2A agent card URL, if it has one

description.description: What the agent does, in plain words

imageBase64.description: The image as base64, up to about 700 KB

imageCid.description: An image already on IPFS (a CID from upload_token_metadata or an earlier profile)

imageUrl.description: Public https image (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 5 MB)

mcp.description: The agent's own MCP endpoint, if it serves one

wallet.description: The agent's wallet that will send the transaction and own the ID

x.description: The agent's X account: @handle or https://x.com/handle

name: prepare_agent_id
